name: Venomancer: Vizier Form grants the polymorph immunity its tooltip promises (#12429)
contract: #12429: Vizier Form (800912) says it makes you immune to polymorph effects, but its effects (auras 313, 36
and 286 in Spell.dbc) carry no mechanic immunity and aura_ascension_venomancer_lifecycle granted it only to
Weaver Form (#11699). Hex (11641) has Mechanic 17 (MECHANIC_POLYMORPH), so native Unit::IsImmunedToSpell
must report immunity while Vizier Form is active and stop reporting it once the form ends.

steps.label: SETUP: Hex is not blocked before the form
DISCRIMINATING: Hex is blocked in Vizier Form
DISCRIMINATING: Hex is no longer blocked after the form
